Static review only of `scripts/world/iris_workshop.gd` diff — no blocking reproducible defects.

API/lifecycle: `PanelContainer+HBox/keycap` + `StyleBoxFlat`/`MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE` valid; created once in `_ready`, `update_near` only toggles `visible` + `flip_h`; `_rebuild` free pattern unchanged. Proximity/input: grounded + `<90.0` to `IRIS_POSITION` preserved, plus `not is_open()` + `not paused` correctly hides in-world prompt when overlay open; `E` bind unchanged in lobby. Open/close: reset of `_message`/`_dialogue_response` on `open` prevents stale copy; `_prompt.hide()` before pause overlay preserved. Copy/economy: `_opening_dialogue` covers invalid/pending/maxed/affordable/`marks==0`/insufficient; success `+1 PV`/`+2 sucata na próxima subida` matches `health/scrap max 2, 2 then 4`; `_buy` respects `WorkshopSave.buy()` true-only-after-save, failure generic without claiming debit, state/pending/marks still shown for retry. Focus/layout: `AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART`, `is_instance_valid+not disabled` with `close` fallback preserved; `preferred_key` still passed to `_rebuild`; title `28->25` + dialogue `15 EXPAND_FILL` reduces overflow risk on `1152x648`, layers `workshop 80>tutorial 20<pause 300` unchanged.
